summary.logicalPathPolicy: Exact normalized original path, source-tree stripped alias and context-relative path; ambiguous matches retain every matching SHA; explicit local imports resolve source extensions. No basename-only global lookup.
summary.archivePolicy: Magic and logical extension detection; recursive ZIP/TAR/gzip member inspection; no extraction to runtime; unsupported/encrypted/corrupt/limited retained archive triggers global candidate hold.
summary.scopeSeparation: retainedShas contains proven roots and observed transitive references only; unknown ZIP dependencies add physical holds, never inferred metadata retention.
